In Adalat O Ekti Meye, Tanuja played a woman gangraped on a beach. Her only ally in a perverted courtroom was a cop who never got promoted, played by Bengali stage legend Manoj Mitra, an oddball like the weird lawyer character of Bachchan in Pink #MeToo 
https://t.co/Y2fEv54ubn

October, the month of #MeToo in India, I remember the superb progressive legacy of the courtroom drama in films on rape: Tapan Sinhas Adalat o Ekti Meye, Rituparno Ghosh's Dahan, Anirudh Roychowdhury's Pink and my favourite, Jonathan Kaplan's The Accused
